text:
## Audit & Compliance  
**Internal Audit:**
- Annual GDPR compliance testing
- Data protection control testing
- Subject access request sampling
- Breach response procedures  
**Regulatory Audit:**
- ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) examination (if triggered)
- Periodic data protection inspections
- Privacy by design assessments  
---
name: Chunk 32/36

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Compliance Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing data protection compliance obligations, including annual GDPR testing, data protection control testing, subject access request handling, and breach response procedures. The policy is subject to regulatory oversight by the Information Commissioner's Office and includes periodic inspections and privacy by design assessments.

raw_entities.name: Annual GDPR Compliance Testing
raw_entities.description: A mandatory annual testing requirement to verify compliance with GDPR obligations. This provision is part of the internal audit function and ensures ongoing adherence to data protection regulations.

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Control Testing
raw_entities.description: A requirement to test data protection controls as part of internal audit procedures. This ensures that technical and operational safeguards protecting personal data are functioning effectively.

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request Sampling
raw_entities.description: A sampling-based audit procedure to verify that subject access requests are being handled in compliance with data protection obligations. This provision ensures quality and timeliness of responses to data subject requests.

raw_entities.name: Breach Response Procedures Audit
raw_entities.description: An internal audit requirement to test and verify the effectiveness of breach response procedures. This ensures the organization can respond promptly and appropriately to data protection incidents.

raw_entities.name: Privacy by Design Assessment
raw_entities.description: A regulatory audit requirement to assess whether privacy by design principles are embedded in the organization's systems, processes, and operations. This is conducted periodically as part of data protection inspections.

raw_entities.name: General Data Protection Regulation
raw_entities.description: The primary EU data protection regulation governing the processing of personal data. The policy mandates annual compliance testing and periodic inspections to ensure adherence to GDPR requirements.

raw_entities.name: Information Commissioner's Office Examination
raw_entities.description: Regulatory oversight and examination authority responsible for data protection compliance in the UK. The ICO may trigger examinations and conduct periodic data protection inspections of the organization.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: The unauthorized access, loss, or compromise of personal data. The policy addresses this risk through breach response procedures that are subject to internal audit testing and regulatory inspection.

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Control Testing
raw_entities.description: An internal audit control mechanism that tests the effectiveness of data protection controls. This measure verifies that technical and operational safeguards are functioning as designed.

raw_entities.name: Subject Access Request Sampling
raw_entities.description: An audit sampling control that verifies subject access requests are being processed and responded to in compliance with data protection obligations. This ensures quality assurance of data subject request handling.

raw_entities.name: Breach Response Procedures
raw_entities.description: Operational procedures designed to detect, respond to, and report data protection breaches. These procedures are subject to internal audit testing to ensure effectiveness and compliance.

raw_entities.name: Privacy by Design Assessment
raw_entities.description: A regulatory audit control that evaluates whether privacy principles are embedded throughout the organization's systems, processes, and operations. This is conducted periodically as part of data protection inspections.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Function
raw_entities.description: The organizational function responsible for conducting annual GDPR compliance testing, data protection control testing, subject access request sampling, and breach response procedure audits. This function reports on compliance status and control effectiveness.

raw_entities.name: Information Commissioner's Office
raw_entities.description: The UK regulatory authority responsible for data protection oversight. The ICO has authority to conduct examinations and periodic data protection inspections to verify organizational compliance with data protection obligations.
